rv.q: All one can say is that, with this and One Man, Two Guvnors running simultaneously, London boasts two of the funniest plays you could ever hope to see and echoes with the sound of laughter.
As much a masterpiece as the Mona Lisa, Noises Off is one of the very few plays you must see before you die.
For the rest of the evening, expert acting by a fine cast yields plenty of laughter.
It is, in my humble opinion, the greatest farce ever written.
